#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Scratch command runner: the repository's shared/exclusive flock protocol."""
import argparse
import fcntl
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--label', required=True)
p.add_argument('--cwd', required=True)
p.add_argument('--exclusive', action='store_true')
p.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
a = p.parse_args()
command = a.command[1:] if a.command[:1] == ['--'] else a.command
root = Path('/data/mini_linq-wt/p5-joins/target/p5-joins')
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
env = os.environ.copy()
env.update(CARGO_INCREMENTAL='0', CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG='line-tables-only',
           CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG='line-tables-only', CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='6')
request = time.monotonic()
with open('/tmp/mini_linq-timing-gate.lock', 'a') as gate, open('/tmp/mini_linq-timing.lock', 'a') as timing:
    fcntl.flock(gate, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
    if not a.exclusive:
        fcntl.flock(gate, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
    fcntl.flock(timing, fcntl.LOCK_EX if a.exclusive else fcntl.LOCK_SH)
    start = time.monotonic()
    log = root / (a.label + '.log')
    print(json.dumps({'label': a.label, 'command': command, 'lock_wait_seconds': start-request}), flush=True)
    with log.open('w') as output:
        result = subprocess.run(['nice', '-n', '10', *command], cwd=a.cwd, env=env,
                                stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    elapsed = time.monotonic()-start
    record = {'label': a.label, 'command': command, 'cwd': a.cwd,
              'lock_mode': 'exclusive' if a.exclusive else 'shared',
              'lock_wait_seconds': start-request, 'gate_seconds': elapsed,
              'returncode': result.returncode, 'log': str(log)}
    with (root/'gates.jsonl').open('a') as output:
        output.write(json.dumps(record)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
